title: Add getByInviteCodeAsync endpoint to CarnivalBlocks API + repository
objective: Expose GET /CarnivalBlocks/by-invite-code/{inviteCode} as a typed method on the CarnivalBlocks API client and repository, so the join-block flow can look up exactly one block by its invite code instead of pulling every block in the system and filtering client-side.
description: Currently JoinBlockCubit calls _carnivalBlocksRepository.getAllAsync() and then filters by inviteCode with .where((b) => b.inviteCode == inviteCode).first. This downloads the entire blocks collection (including blocks the user is not a member of, blocks they are a member of, and the metadata of every other carnival block) on every join attempt. The fix adds a dedicated endpoint, plumbs it through the API client interface, the concrete client, the repository interface, and the repository. The Swagger contract in swagger.json should be inspected first; if the backend already exposes by-invite-code (or by-manager-invite-code), this is purely client-side wiring. If it does NOT, the subtask surfaces a `// TODO(backend): add GET /CarnivalBlocks/by-invite-code/{code}` comment so H2b can still call a typed method that throws UnimplementedError until the backend ships — preserving type safety in JoinBlockCubit.
